result.summary: Independently re-measured the ISS-0148 fix. PRIMARY CRITERION NOT MET: zig build test-integration-tnt exit codes over 5 consecutive runs were 1, 1, 0, 1, 0 (2/5 pass), judged by exit code only. BACKEND-DEV's reported 5/5 PASS did not reproduce. HOWEVER the fix itself is correct and regression-free: the target signature 42P01 'relation "audit_entries" does not exist' occurs 0 times across all 5 post-fix runs while still occurring in a clean origin/main control, and a 3-run control on clean main gave 0, 1, 1 - so the step is flaky BOTH before and after the fix and the residual flakiness is NOT introduced by this change. Residual cause is a distinct 23505 on schema_migrations_schema_version_uq (tenant_<uuid>, 001_event_store.sql), present identically on main, filed as ISS-0151/GH #483. TC-TNT-01-01 passes. Regression sweep over 6 unrelated integration suites + zig build test: unit 0, iss101 0, iss102 0, iss103 0, iss107 0, iss0121 0, iss106 1 (pre-existing, identical on main), svc 1 (pre-existing ISS-0150, byte-identical 9x42P01 counts on branch and main - independently confirmed, not re-filed). No regression attributable to the 43-site addIntegrationRun() rewiring. Also filed ISS-0152/GH #484: health-checklist item C5 fails unconditionally on main.
